# League-2 Start/Sit Briefing -- Week 10, Saturday final call

**Source and freshness:** Committed fixture `weekly-report-week-10.json` (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries), generated 2026-11-10T17:16:28Z -- about 3.5 days old. Overlaid with a live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` Week 10 pull (300 rows, every team has filed) run this morning, 2026-11-14. **Not live** for projections or news; the injury overlay is live and confirms no new designations for anyone on this roster who still has a game to play. Thursday's NYG@WAS game is final; Cam Skattebo and Isaiah Likely (both NYG) already played and their scores are locked regardless of this report.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Tyler Shough | at CAR | **18.48** | 0.973 | 19.00 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs MIA | **16.60** | 0.959 | 17.31 |
| RB | *(no eligible player -- see below)* | -- | **0.00** | -- | -- |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs LV | **23.01** | 0.972 | 23.66 |
| WR | Tee Higgins | at PIT | **16.58** | 0.971 | 17.07 |
| FLEX | Drake London | vs KC | **16.01** | 0.972 | 16.46 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | vs NE | **11.93** | 0.971 | 12.29 |
| TE | Sam LaPorta | vs NE | **11.89** | 0.952 | 12.48 |
| K | Jake Bates | vs NE | **8.34** | 0.987 | 8.45 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | vs BUF | **5.28** | 1.000 | 5.28 |
| **Total** | | | **128.12** | | |

**RB2 is empty, and that's real, not a bug.** Bucky Irving is on bye (TB, confirmed against the 2026 schedule). Cam Skattebo -- the only other rostered RB -- already played Thursday night for NYG; his game is over and nothing in this report can move him into this slot retroactively. If your platform allows a same-day free-agent add, do it before Sunday's early games; a standard waiver claim will not clear in time. Streaming names outside this roster's usual rostered tier (not confirmed as actually available in your 8-team league): Omarion Hampton, Rico Dowdle, Devin Singletary, Zach Charbonnet.

**Bench, sit:** Matthew Stafford (QB, 15.72 -- below Shough), Jalen Coker (WR, 10.27 -- below both FLEX starters). Bo Nix (QB) is on bye. Skattebo and Likely (TE) already played Thursday and cannot be used again this week.

## Changes since Wednesday (2026-11-11)

No lineup swaps for the nine open Sunday/Monday slots -- Shough over Stafford and Jameson Williams over Coker both carry forward unchanged. The only real change is informational: Thursday's NYG@WAS game is now final, closing out whatever RB2/TE assignment was actually locked in for that game (unverifiable from this session). Going forward, RB2 has no occupant and TE must be LaPorta, since Likely has no game left this week.

## Watch list

- **Jameson Williams vs. Jalen Coker (FLEX):** only a 1.66-point edge, the thinnest margin in the lineup. No DET injury row has posted. Recheck Sunday morning inactives before the 1:00pm ET lock.
- **RB2:** empty. Check the waiver wire / free-agent pool before Sunday's early window.

## Opponent notes

- Jets D/ST draws Buffalo's offense, the toughest matchup in this lineup -- no bench alternative at DEF, so it starts anyway.
- Tee Higgins is on the road at Pittsburgh; still the roster's clear #2 WR despite the tougher matchup.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 11:** Matthew Stafford (QB, LAR), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR, SEA), Drake London (WR, ATL) -- all three out simultaneously. Start planning FLEX/QB replacements now; this is the same triple bye flagged in every briefing since early November.

## Caveats

- RB2's empty slot is a genuine roster hole (Irving bye + Skattebo's game already played), not a pipeline failure -- see the sanity-check note above for why 128.12 across nine starters is the right number this week.
- All conditionalPoints above come straight from the committed fixture; this run did not recompute projections.
- Cannot verify whether Thursday's Skattebo/Likely start recommendation was actually applied in the live Sleeper lineup before kickoff -- check the app if it matters; it doesn't change anything in this report either way.
